name: Banana Peanut Butter Oatmeal
description: Creamy stovetop oats with sliced banana and a spoon of peanut butter
instructions: Put the oats, milk and a pinch of salt in a small pot over medium heat
Simmer for 4 to 5 minutes, stirring often, until thick and creamy
Slice the banana and stir half of it into the oats
Pour into a bowl and top with the rest of the banana, the peanut butter and a little cinnamon

name: Apple Cinnamon Oatmeal
description: Warm oats cooked with diced apple, cinnamon and a drizzle of honey
instructions: Core the apple and cut it into small cubes
Put the oats, milk, cinnamon, salt and two thirds of the apple in a small pot
Simmer over medium heat for 5 to 6 minutes, stirring often, until the oats are soft
Serve topped with the remaining apple and the honey

name: Coconut Berry Overnight Oats
description: No-cook oats soaked overnight in coconut milk, topped with berries
instructions: Stir the oats, coconut milk, water and salt together in a jar or bowl
Cover and leave in the fridge overnight, or for at least 4 hours
In the morning stir well and loosen with a splash of water if it is too thick
Slice the strawberries and serve the oats topped with both berries

name: Peanut Butter Banana Toast
description: Toasted wholemeal bread with peanut butter and banana slices
instructions: Toast the bread until golden
Spread the peanut butter over both slices
Slice the banana, lay it on top and dust with cinnamon

name: Avocado Tomato Toast
description: Smashed avocado on toast with fresh tomato, lemon and olive oil
instructions: Toast the bread
Halve the avocado, scoop the flesh into a bowl and mash it with a fork, salt, pepper and a squeeze of lemon
Slice the tomato
Spread the avocado on the toast, top with tomato, drizzle with the olive oil and finish with chili flakes

name: Avocado Toast with Fried Eggs
description: Wholemeal toast with smashed avocado and two fried eggs
instructions: Toast the bread
Mash the avocado with salt and pepper and spread it over the toast
Heat the oil in a pan over medium heat and fry the eggs for 2 to 3 minutes until the whites are set
Slide an egg onto each slice and season with pepper and chili flakes

name: Greek Yogurt Berry Bowl
description: Thick Greek yogurt with blueberries, strawberries and honey
instructions: Spoon the yogurt into a bowl
Halve or slice the strawberries
Top the yogurt with the berries and drizzle with the honey

name: Apple Bircher Muesli
description: Oats soaked in yogurt with grated apple and honey
instructions: Coarsely grate the apple, leaving the core behind
Stir the oats, yogurt, grated apple and cinnamon together in a bowl
Leave for at least 10 minutes, or overnight in the fridge, so the oats soften
Drizzle with the honey before serving

name: Spinach and Feta Scrambled Eggs
description: Soft scrambled eggs with wilted spinach, feta and fresh tomato
instructions: Beat the eggs with a little pepper; the feta is salty, so add no salt
Melt the butter in a pan over medium heat and wilt the spinach for about 1 minute
Pour in the eggs and stir gently for 2 to 3 minutes until just set
Crumble in the feta, fold once and serve with the sliced tomato

name: Pepper and Mushroom Omelette
description: A folded three-egg omelette filled with peppers, mushrooms and onion
instructions: Dice the pepper and onion and slice the mushrooms
Heat the oil in a non-stick pan and cook the vegetables for 4 to 5 minutes until soft, then tip them onto a plate
Beat the eggs with salt and pepper, pour into the pan and cook over medium heat until almost set
Spoon the vegetables over one half, fold the omelette over and cook 1 more minute

name: Ham and Cheese Omelette with Toast
description: A quick omelette with ham and melted cheese, served with buttered toast
instructions: Beat the eggs with pepper, cut the ham into strips and grate the cheese
Melt half the butter in a non-stick pan over medium heat and pour in the eggs
When the eggs are almost set, scatter the ham and cheese over one half and fold the omelette over
Cook 1 more minute until the cheese melts and serve with the toasted, buttered bread

name: Bacon and Eggs with Toast
description: Crispy bacon, fried eggs and pan-warmed tomato with toast
instructions: Lay the bacon in a cold pan and cook over medium heat for 5 to 6 minutes, turning once, until crisp, then move it to a plate
Halve the tomato and fry it cut side down in the bacon fat for 2 minutes
Fry the eggs in the same pan for 2 to 3 minutes until the whites are set
Toast the bread and serve everything together with a little pepper

name: Tofu Scramble on Toast
description: Golden scrambled tofu with spinach and peppers on wholemeal toast
instructions: Finely dice the onion and pepper and cook them in the oil over medium heat for 3 minutes
Crumble the tofu into the pan with your hands and add the turmeric, salt and pepper
Cook for 4 to 5 minutes, stirring, until the tofu is hot and lightly golden
Stir in the spinach until it wilts and pile the scramble onto the toasted bread

name: Chickpea and Potato Breakfast Hash
description: Crispy pan-fried potatoes with chickpeas, onion and spinach
instructions: Cut the potatoes into 1 cm cubes and dice the onion
Heat the oil in a wide pan and fry the potatoes over medium heat for 12 to 15 minutes, turning now and then, until golden and tender
Add the onion, drained chickpeas, paprika, salt and pepper and cook 4 more minutes
Stir in the spinach until it wilts and serve hot

name: Shakshuka
description: Eggs poached in a spiced tomato and pepper sauce
instructions: Slice the onion and pepper and finely chop the garlic
Heat the olive oil in a small pan and soften the onion and pepper for 5 minutes, then add the garlic and spices for 1 minute
Pour in the chopped tomatoes, season and simmer for 8 to 10 minutes until slightly thickened
Make {n:eggs} wells in the sauce, crack in the eggs, cover and cook 4 to 5 minutes until the whites are set

name: Cottage Cheese Bowl with Apple and Honey
description: High-protein cottage cheese with crisp apple, honey and cinnamon
instructions: Spoon the cottage cheese into a bowl
Core the apple and cut it into thin slices or small cubes
Top the cottage cheese with the apple, drizzle with honey and dust with cinnamon

name: Pancakes with Strawberries
description: Thin homemade pancakes with fresh strawberries and honey
instructions: Whisk the flour, egg, milk and salt into a smooth batter and let it rest for 5 minutes
Melt a little of the butter in a non-stick pan over medium heat
Pour in a thin layer of batter, cook about 1 minute per side until golden, and repeat with the rest of the batter
Slice the strawberries and serve the pancakes topped with them and the honey

name: Banana Egg Pancakes
description: Flourless two-ingredient pancakes with blueberries
instructions: Mash the banana very smooth in a bowl, then whisk in the eggs and cinnamon
Heat the oil in a non-stick pan over medium-low heat
Drop in small spoonfuls of batter and cook about 2 minutes per side, turning carefully
Serve topped with the blueberries

name: Breakfast Burrito
description: A warm tortilla filled with scrambled eggs, beans, cheese and tomato
instructions: Dice the tomato, grate the cheese and drain the beans
Heat the oil in a pan, warm the beans with the cumin for 1 minute, then pour in the beaten eggs and scramble until just set
Warm the tortilla in a dry pan for 20 seconds per side
Fill it with the eggs and beans, cheese and tomato, fold in the sides and roll up

name: Sweet Potato and Bean Hash
description: Pan-fried sweet potato with kidney beans, peppers and onion
instructions: Peel the sweet potato and cut it into 1 cm cubes; dice the onion and pepper
Heat the olive oil in a wide pan and fry the sweet potato over medium heat for 10 to 12 minutes until tender and browned
Add the onion, pepper and spices and cook 4 more minutes
Stir in the drained beans, heat through for 2 minutes and season to taste

name: Spicy Egg and Avocado Breakfast Taco
description: Tortilla with chili scrambled eggs, avocado and tomato
instructions: Beat the eggs with the chili flakes and salt and scramble them in the oil over medium heat for 2 minutes
Mash the avocado with lime juice and a pinch of salt
Warm the tortilla in a dry pan, spread with the avocado and top with the eggs and diced tomato

name: Chili Scrambled Eggs on Toast
description: Soft scrambled eggs with chili and tomato on buttered toast
instructions: Beat the eggs with the chili flakes and salt
Melt the butter in a pan over medium-low heat, add the diced tomato for 1 minute, then pour in the eggs
Stir gently for 2 to 3 minutes until softly set
Pile onto the toasted bread

name: Spicy Tofu and Bean Breakfast Wrap
description: Tortilla with chili tofu scramble, kidney beans and peppers
instructions: Dice the peppers and cook them in the oil for 2 minutes
Crumble in the tofu with the chili flakes, cumin, turmeric and salt and cook for 4 minutes
Add the drained kidney beans and heat through
Warm the tortilla, add the filling and roll up

name: Harissa Chickpeas on Toast
description: Warm spiced chickpeas with tomato and spinach on toast
instructions: Warm the olive oil in a pan and cook the diced tomato with the harissa for 2 minutes
Add the drained chickpeas and cook for 3 minutes, lightly crushing some of them
Stir in the spinach until wilted and season with salt and lemon juice
Spoon over the toasted bread

name: Menemen
description: Turkish eggs scrambled into soft tomatoes and peppers, with bread
instructions: Dice the onion and peppers and soften them in the olive oil for 4 minutes
Add the chopped tomato, chili flakes, paprika and salt and cook for 5 minutes until saucy
Pour in the lightly beaten eggs and stir gently for 2 minutes until just set
Serve from the pan with the bread

name: Yogurt, Banana and Oat Bowl
description: Plain yogurt with banana, strawberries and a handful of oats
instructions: Spoon the yogurt into a bowl and stir in the oats
Slice the banana and strawberries
Top the yogurt with the fruit and a pinch of cinnamon

name: Cottage Cheese and Tomato Toast
description: Toast piled with cottage cheese, tomato and cucumber
instructions: Toast the bread
Spread the cottage cheese over both slices
Top with the sliced tomato and cucumber and season with salt, pepper and oregano

name: Fruit Salad with Yogurt
description: Apple, banana and berries with plain yogurt
instructions: Core and dice the apple and slice the banana and strawberries
Toss all the fruit, including the blueberries, with a squeeze of lemon juice
Serve with the yogurt spooned over

name: Dairy-Free Banana Berry Porridge
description: Oats cooked in water with mashed banana, blueberries and peanut butter
instructions: Mash half the banana and put it in a pot with the oats, water and salt
Simmer for 5 minutes, stirring, until thick and creamy
Stir in half the blueberries
Serve topped with the remaining banana, sliced, the rest of the blueberries, the peanut butter and cinnamon

name: Strawberry Banana Smoothie Bowl
description: Thick blended yogurt and fruit bowl topped with oats and honey
instructions: Blend the yogurt with half the banana and two thirds of the strawberries until smooth and thick
Pour into a bowl
Top with the remaining banana and strawberries, sliced, the oats and the honey

name: French Toast with Strawberries
description: Egg-soaked bread fried in butter, with strawberries and honey
instructions: Beat the eggs with the milk, cinnamon and salt in a shallow dish
Soak each slice of bread in the mixture for 20 seconds per side
Fry in the butter over medium heat for 2 to 3 minutes per side until golden
Serve topped with the sliced strawberries and the honey

name: Full Cooked Breakfast
description: Bacon, fried eggs, mushrooms and tomato with buttered toast
instructions: Cook the bacon in a dry pan over medium heat for 5 to 6 minutes until crisp and move it to a plate
Fry the halved mushrooms and the halved tomato in the bacon fat for 4 minutes
Push them aside and fry the eggs for 2 to 3 minutes until the whites are set
Serve everything with the toasted, buttered bread and a little pepper

name: Egg, Ham and Cheese Toastie
description: Pan-toasted sandwich with a fried egg, ham and melted cheese
instructions: Fry the egg in half the butter for 2 minutes, flip it and cook 30 seconds more
Layer the ham, egg and sliced cheese between the bread
Toast the sandwich in the remaining butter over medium heat for 2 minutes per side until golden and the cheese melts

name: Scrambled Eggs with Salmon on Toast
description: Soft scrambled eggs folded with flaked salmon on buttered toast
instructions: Fry the salmon in a non-stick pan over medium heat for 3 minutes per side, then break it into flakes
Melt the butter in the pan, pour in the beaten eggs and stir gently for 2 minutes until softly set
Fold in the salmon
Serve on the toasted bread with pepper and lemon juice

name: Banana Oat Pancakes
description: Blender pancakes made from oats, banana and egg, with blueberries
instructions: Blend the oats, banana, egg, milk, cinnamon and salt into a smooth batter and let it stand for 2 minutes
Heat the oil in a non-stick pan over medium heat
Cook small pancakes for about 2 minutes per side until golden
Serve topped with the blueberries

name: Cheese and Tomato Omelette
description: Three-egg omelette with melted cheese and fresh tomato
instructions: Beat the eggs with salt and pepper and dice the tomato
Melt the butter in a non-stick pan over medium heat and pour in the eggs
When almost set, scatter the grated cheese and tomato over one half
Fold over and cook 1 more minute

name: Avocado and Chickpea Smash on Toast
description: Toast topped with avocado and chickpeas mashed with lemon
instructions: Toast the bread
Mash the avocado and drained chickpeas roughly with the juice of the lemon, salt and pepper
Pile onto the toast and dust with paprika

name: Tofu and Vegetable Scramble
description: Scrambled tofu with mushrooms, spinach and tomato
instructions: Slice the mushrooms and fry them in the oil for 3 minutes
Crumble in the tofu with the turmeric, salt and pepper and cook for 4 minutes
Add the diced tomato and spinach and cook until the spinach wilts

name: Creamy Rice Porridge with Cinnamon Apple
description: Rice simmered in milk until creamy, topped with apple and honey
instructions: Put the rice, milk and salt in a pot and bring to a gentle simmer
Cook on low heat for 25 to 30 minutes, stirring often, until the rice is soft and the porridge is creamy
Dice the apple and stir half of it in for the last 5 minutes
Serve topped with the remaining apple, the honey and the cinnamon

name: Feta, Tomato and Egg Toast
description: Toast with crumbled feta, tomato, olive oil and a fried egg
instructions: Toast the bread and top it with the sliced tomato and crumbled feta
Fry the egg in the olive oil for 2 to 3 minutes
Put the egg on top and finish with oregano and pepper

name: Big Breakfast Burrito
description: Two tortillas filled with scrambled eggs, beans, cheese and tomato
instructions: Warm the drained kidney beans with the cumin in the oil for 1 minute
Pour in the beaten eggs, season and scramble until just set
Warm the tortillas in a dry pan
Divide the eggs and beans, grated cheese and diced tomato between them, fold in the sides and roll up

name: Peanut Butter Protein Oats
description: Thick oats with Greek yogurt, peanut butter and banana
instructions: Simmer the oats with the milk and salt for 4 to 5 minutes, stirring, until thick
Take off the heat and stir in half the yogurt
Top with the rest of the yogurt, the sliced banana, the peanut butter and cinnamon

name: Egg, Bacon and Cheese Sandwich
description: Triple-decker toasted sandwich with fried eggs, bacon and cheese
instructions: Fry the bacon in a dry pan over medium heat for 4 to 5 minutes until crisp and set it aside
Fry the eggs in the bacon fat for 2 minutes, flip and cook 30 seconds more
Toast the bread and butter it
Stack the sandwich with the eggs, bacon and sliced cheese between the slices and season with pepper

name: Salmon, Avocado and Egg Toast
description: Toast with avocado, flaked salmon and fried eggs
instructions: Fry the salmon in a non-stick pan over medium heat for 3 minutes per side and break it into flakes
Fry the eggs in the same pan for 2 to 3 minutes
Toast the bread and spread it with the avocado mashed with lemon juice and salt
Top with the salmon and eggs and season with pepper

name: Loaded Potato, Ham and Cheese Omelette
description: Three-egg omelette over fried potatoes with ham and cheese
instructions: Cut the potatoes into small cubes and fry them in the oil over medium heat for 10 to 12 minutes until golden and tender
Add the ham cut into strips for 1 minute
Pour over the beaten eggs, seasoned with salt and pepper, and cook gently for 3 minutes until almost set
Scatter with the grated cheese, cover for 1 minute until it melts and fold in half

name: Tofu Scramble Burrito
description: Two tortillas filled with spiced tofu scramble and kidney beans
instructions: Crumble the tofu into the hot oil with the turmeric, cumin, paprika and salt and cook for 5 minutes
Add the drained kidney beans and heat through for 2 minutes
Warm the tortillas in a dry pan
Divide the filling between them, fold in the sides and roll up

name: Peanut Butter Banana Overnight Oats
description: Dairy-free overnight oats with coconut milk, peanut butter and banana
instructions: Stir the oats, coconut milk, water, salt and half the peanut butter together in a jar or bowl
Cover and leave in the fridge overnight, or for at least 4 hours
Stir well, loosen with a splash of water if needed and top with the sliced banana, the remaining peanut butter and cinnamon

name: Greek Yogurt Power Bowl
description: Big bowl of Greek yogurt with banana, blueberries, peanut butter and honey
instructions: Spoon the yogurt into a bowl
Slice the banana and arrange it on top with the blueberries
Add the peanut butter in small spoonfuls, drizzle with the honey and dust with cinnamon

name: Cheesy Egg and Spinach Quesadilla
description: Crisp tortillas filled with scrambled egg, spinach and melted cheese
instructions: Melt the butter in a pan, wilt the spinach for 30 seconds, then pour in the beaten eggs and scramble until just set
Cover one tortilla with half the grated cheese, the eggs and the rest of the cheese, and top with the second tortilla
Wipe out the pan and cook the quesadilla over medium heat for 2 minutes per side until crisp
Cut into wedges

name: Banana Pancake Stack
description: Thick pancakes with banana, butter and honey
instructions: Whisk the flour, eggs, milk and salt into a smooth, thick batter and rest it for 5 minutes
Melt a little of the butter in a non-stick pan over medium heat
Cook small thick pancakes for about 2 minutes per side until golden, adding butter as needed
Stack them with the sliced banana, drizzle with the honey and dust with cinnamon

name: Tofu and Bean Breakfast Plate
description: Scrambled tofu with kidney beans, tomato and spinach, and a slice of toast
instructions: Heat the oil in a pan over medium heat, crumble in the tofu and fry it with the turmeric, salt and black pepper for 4 minutes
Add the drained beans and the diced tomato and cook for 3 minutes
Stir in the spinach until wilted, and toast the bread meanwhile
Serve the scramble with the toast
